title: Rory and the Shimmering Fern Valley
verses:
The silver moon shone softly on the hill,
The night was quiet, beautiful, and still.
Then Rory walked along a mossy trail,
And watched a sleepy firefly flick its tail.

Then Tilly sat and let out one soft sigh,
As Nia swooped across the midnight sky.
They found a glowing grove of giant ferns,
Where starlight danced in quiet, cozy turns.

Then Benny stretched his neck up to the trees,
And felt the blowing of a nighttime breeze.
While Ricky curled right up upon a log,
Beside a happy, sleepy little frog.

Psittaco tucked right into Rory's bed,
And rested down a peaceful, weary head.
The ferns were glowing softly in the night,
To fill the sleepy vale with cozy light.

The friends all snuggled close upon the floor,
And no one wished to play there anymore.
The stars above began to blink and gleam,
To carry every friend into a dream.

Now Rory closed his eyes and drifted deep,
While all his weary friends were fast asleep.
A gentle breeze hummed out a lullaby,
Beneath the quiet, velvet bedtime sky.
